entry.content:
In 1924, after a road race through France, W.O. Bentley decided his engine needed to be bigger, and as a result, a six-cylinder 6½ Litre was shown at London's Olympia Motor Show in 1926. For that centenary, Mulliner, Bentley's bespoke division, is building 12 Continental GTs. Each car's paint fades from forest green on the nose to near-black Midnight Emerald on the tail. The finish takes 56 hours by hand, and Champagne Gold highlights the badges, pinstripe and wheel faces. When a door opens, a light projects the Lyon-to-Dieppe route onto the ground, and the same route is embroidered across the ski hatch. The cabin pairs Coach Green and Cumbrian Green leather with black-stained walnut. Every owner also receives a Brooklands chronograph numbered to match the car.

entry.content:
A decade after its debut, CLAE's Bradley gets a considered update with the Bradley Venice, a refined take on the court-inspired staple that adds a little more presence underfoot without losing its clean profile. The White Navy White colorway pairs a smooth Italian Nappa leather upper sourced from LWG-certified tanneries with a tonal white Venice Premium sole and subtle navy heel accent. The slightly thicker sole incorporates 30% natural rubber and a hidden EVA insert for lightweight cushioning and flexibility, while an insole made with 80% recycled PU foam adds another layer of comfort. Finished with leather and recycled polyester lining, it's a versatile everyday sneaker that works just as well with washed denim as relaxed tailoring.

entry.content:
BMW is capping the M 1000 RS at 1,000 bikes worldwide, and each one is engraved "1 of 1000" on its triple clamp. The naked sport bike pairs the M RR superbike's 999 cc inline-four with a street chassis, and its name nods to Rennsport, German for racing sport. The engine makes 205 horsepower in a bike that weighs 432 pounds ready to ride, and it reaches 124 miles per hour in 7.2 seconds. Matte carbon winglets with RS lettering and carbon wheels give it a race bike's look, and a titanium exhaust saves 3.5 pounds. A carbon cover sits over the brushed aluminum tank.

entry.content:
AWA's latest Steel bottle takes a material-first approach to everyday hydration, pairing a deep KARBON BLACK lid with the brand's signature brushed stainless steel body. Crafted entirely from marine-grade 316L stainless steel, the 650mL bottle is electropolished on the inside at a microscopic level to create an exceptionally smooth surface that resists corrosion, buildup, and lingering tastes or odors, eliminating the need for plastic liners or interior coatings. Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours or hot for up to 12, while a patented double-sealed lid helps prevent leaks and keeps carbonation crisp for longer. The brushed steel body remains exposed beneath a deep black lid marked by subtle, individually unique strokes, giving the bottle a restrained contrast that feels as considered as its construction. From morning coffee to sparkling water on the trail, KARBON BLACK is built to go anywhere.

entry.content:
Ring's Drone Cam is an indoor-only flying camera that patrols your home on command. During setup, you carry it through your rooms so it can map the space. After that, tap a spot on the map, a saved viewpoint or a room in the Ring app, and the camera takes off from its dock. It records 2K video with a 148-degree view, then returns to recharge after each flight or when the battery runs low. Two LED spotlights light dark rooms, since it has no infrared night vision, and it records only while airborne, so nothing is filmed once it's docked. Flights last up to 8 minutes, and a Ring subscription, free for the first 30 days, adds scheduled patrols along routes you set.

entry.content:
Battlefleet Duo is a free naval strategy game built around the iPhone Duo's fold. Half-fold the phone and your fleet fills the lower screen, with the enemy's sea standing upright across from you. Each side hides a five-ship fleet on a 10-by-10 grid and trades shots in turns. An optional Enhanced rule set arms every ship with a weapon, either an air strike, torpedo, star shell or missile. A ship loses its weapon when it sinks. Two half-folded phones set back to back make a face-to-face match, and you can also play the computer, pass one phone around or go online through Game Center. Two battles a day are free, and a single purchase unlocks unlimited play.

Yaamava' Resort & Casino at San Manuel is marking its 500th car giveaway with its most ambitious prize yet: a 2026 Rolls-Royce Spectre, the luxury marque's first all-electric model. From October 1 through November 30, Club Serrano members earn one entry for every 100 points toward the grand finale drawing, where one winner will drive away in the all-electric luxury coupe.
